# NEW 2026-11-20 v6.7 L6 the elder line, John VII 1390 (phases 1-2). Generated by gen_john7.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope, monthly. Called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES, id 31); this line writes no
# monthly hook of its own. Order (design 3.3): start, the claimant, the new reign, events, close.
oe_j7_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_j7_off } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_j7_live } } set_global_variable = oe_j7_live }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_j7_on } } set_variable = oe_j7_on }
        set_variable = { name = oe_j7_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
        if = {
            limit = { current_date >= 1403.1.1 }
            oe_j7_close = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { current_date >= 1386.1.1 }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_j7_st_1 } oe_j7_has_claim = no } oe_j7_pick = yes }
            oe_j7_reign_tick = yes
            oe_j7_p2_tick = yes
            oe_j7_events = yes
            if = { limit = { OR = { oe_j7_story_over = yes AND = { current_date >= 1393.1.1 oe_j7_waiting = no } } } oe_j7_close = yes }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The claimant (design 1.5): (1) B2's eldest grandson, alive, a man, in the empire, not the ruler; (2) where
# there is none but B2 settled on the elder line (or the usurper reigned), a John made once at run time; (3) none.
oe_j7_pick = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_vas_grand ?= { oe_j7_grand_fits = yes } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_j7_claimant value = var:oe_vas_grand }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_j7_made }
            OR = { has_global_variable = oe_vas_elder_line has_global_variable = oe_vas_usurped }
        }
        oe_j7_make_john = yes
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Make the claimant once (design 1.5 ②, switch MAKE_FATHER = True); read back by its script key, a
# self-check: failure code 1 when the person is not there afterwards (nothing depends on it).
oe_j7_make_john = {
    set_global_variable = oe_j7_made
    var:oe_vas_heir ?= { save_scope_as = oe_j7_f } if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_j7_f } if = { limit = { current_date >= 1386.1.1 } create_character = { first_name = name_john female = no dynasty = dynasty:palaiologos_dynasty culture = culture:greek_culture religion = religion:orthodox birth_location = location:constantinople script = oe_j7_john father = scope:oe_j7_f birth_date = 1370.1.1 } } else = { create_character = { first_name = name_john female = no dynasty = dynasty:palaiologos_dynasty culture = culture:greek_culture religion = religion:orthodox birth_location = location:constantinople script = oe_j7_john father = scope:oe_j7_f age = 20 } } } else = { if = { limit = { current_date >= 1386.1.1 } create_character = { first_name = name_john female = no dynasty = dynasty:palaiologos_dynasty culture = culture:greek_culture religion = religion:orthodox birth_location = location:constantinople script = oe_j7_john birth_date = 1370.1.1 } } else = { create_character = { first_name = name_john female = no dynasty = dynasty:palaiologos_dynasty culture = culture:greek_culture religion = religion:orthodox birth_location = location:constantinople script = oe_j7_john age = 20 } } }
    character:oe_j7_john ?= { save_scope_as = oe_j7_mj }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_j7_mj }
        scope:oe_j7_mj = { set_variable = oe_j7_made_one }
        set_variable = { name = oe_j7_claimant value = scope:oe_j7_mj }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_j7_fail value = 1 } }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. The new reign (stage 2, design 3.3 item 4): the modifier renewed, the months counted; the claimant
# dead -> job 39; the old emperor dead -> a mark for .3's text.
oe_j7_reign_tick = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_j7_stage ?= 2 }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_j7_new_reign months = 2 mode = replace }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_um } change_variable = { name = oe_j7_um add = 1 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_j7_um value = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_j7_old_dead } NOT = { var:oe_j7_old ?= { is_alive = yes } } } set_variable = oe_j7_old_dead }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_j7_has_claim = no }
            oe_j7_job_39 = yes
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_j7.91
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. Events (design 3.3): lapse, the counter of .2, the elder line giving up (.1 a), then at most one
# event in the order .3 -> .2 -> .1. .2 and .3 do not wait for the lock in their sure month.
oe_j7_events = {
    if = { limit = { oe_j7_no_claim_late = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_st_1 value = 3 } oe_j7_set_end = { v = 9 } }

    if = { limit = { oe_j7_late_2 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_st_2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_j7_gone_4 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_st_4 value = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_j7_late_4 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_st_4 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_j7_gone_6 = yes } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_j7_st_5 } } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_st_5 value = 3 } } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_st_6 value = 3 } oe_j7_set_end2 = { v = 4 } oe_j7_stop_pension = yes }
    if = { limit = { oe_j7_late_5 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_st_5 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_j7_late_6 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_st_6 value = 2 } oe_j7_set_end2 = { v = 5 } oe_j7_stop_pension = yes }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_w2 NOT = { has_variable = oe_j7_st_2 } } change_variable = { name = oe_j7_w2 add = 1 } }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = oe_j7_appeased
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_j7_st_2 }
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_j7_gave_up_rolled }
            has_variable = oe_j7_w2
            var:oe_j7_w2 >= 18
        }
        set_variable = oe_j7_gave_up_rolled
        random = { chance = 50 set_variable = { name = oe_j7_st_2 value = 4 } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_st_3 value = 4 } oe_j7_set_end = { v = 2 } }
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_j7_pick value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_pick = 0 OR = { oe_ml_free = yes var:oe_j7_um >= 6 } oe_j7_ok_3 = yes } random = { chance = oe_j7_ch_3 set_variable = { name = oe_j7_pick value = 3 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_pick = 0 OR = { oe_ml_free = yes var:oe_j7_w2 >= 18 } oe_j7_ok_2 = yes } random = { chance = oe_j7_ch_2 set_variable = { name = oe_j7_pick value = 2 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_pick = 0 oe_ml_free = yes oe_j7_ok_1 = yes } random = { chance = oe_j7_ch_1 set_variable = { name = oe_j7_pick value = 1 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_pick = 0 OR = { oe_ml_free = yes AND = { has_variable = oe_j7_w4 var:oe_j7_w4 >= 8 } } oe_j7_ok_4 = yes } random = { chance = oe_j7_ch_4 set_variable = { name = oe_j7_pick value = 4 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_pick = 0 OR = { oe_ml_free = yes var:oe_j7_m >= 754 } oe_j7_ok_6 = yes } random = { chance = oe_j7_ch_6 set_variable = { name = oe_j7_pick value = 6 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_pick = 0 oe_ml_free = yes oe_j7_ok_5 = yes } random = { chance = oe_j7_ch_5 set_variable = { name = oe_j7_pick value = 5 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_pick = 3 } oe_j7_send_3 = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_pick = 2 } oe_j7_send_2 = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_pick = 1 } oe_j7_send_1 = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_pick = 4 } oe_j7_send_4 = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_pick = 6 } oe_j7_send_6 = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_pick = 5 } oe_j7_send_5 = yes }
    remove_variable = oe_j7_pick
}

# BYZ scope. The sender of each event: its state (st 1), what its text and its roll need (.1 the counter of .2; .2 the
# old emperor and the street chance; .3 the restorer and the restoration chance), then the event. The monthly check and
# the test buttons both use it, so a button shows the event exactly as the month would (r21, brief B9).
oe_j7_send_1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_j7_st_1 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_last value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_w2 value = 0 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_j7.1 }
oe_j7_send_2 = { set_variable = { name = oe_j7_st_2 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_last value = 2 } ruler ?= { save_scope_as = oe_j7_ro } if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_j7_ro } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_old value = scope:oe_j7_ro } } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_street_pct value = oe_j7_street_chance } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_j7.2 }
oe_j7_send_3 = { set_variable = { name = oe_j7_st_3 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_last value = 3 } oe_j7_pick_rest = yes set_variable = { name = oe_j7_restore_pct value = oe_j7_restore_chance } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_j7.3 }
oe_j7_send_4 = { set_variable = { name = oe_j7_st_4 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_last value = 4 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_j7.4 }
oe_j7_send_5 = { set_variable = { name = oe_j7_st_5 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_last value = 5 } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_n5 } change_variable = { name = oe_j7_n5 add = 1 } } else = { set_variable = { name = oe_j7_n5 value = 1 } } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_m } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_m5 value = var:oe_j7_m } } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_j7.5 }
oe_j7_send_6 = { set_variable = { name = oe_j7_st_6 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_last value = 6 } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_recon_pct value = oe_j7_recon_chance } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_j7.6 }

# BYZ scope. The restorer (design 1.5): the empire's heir; B2's second son; the test restorer (button j7mk); the old
# emperor's eldest adult son. Never the claimant, the ruler or the old emperor himself.
oe_j7_pick_rest = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_rest } remove_variable = oe_j7_rest }
    var:oe_j7_claimant ?= { save_scope_as = oe_j7_cl }
    var:oe_j7_old ?= { save_scope_as = oe_j7_o }
    if = { limit = { heir ?= { oe_j7_rest_fits = yes } } heir = { save_scope_as = oe_j7_r } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_vas_second ?= { oe_j7_rest_fits = yes } } var:oe_vas_second = { save_scope_as = oe_j7_r } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_rest_test ?= { oe_j7_rest_fits = yes } } var:oe_j7_rest_test = { save_scope_as = oe_j7_r } }
    else_if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_j7_o }
        scope:oe_j7_o = {
            ordered_child = {
                limit = { oe_j7_rest_fits = yes }
                order_by = age_in_days
                position = 0
                check_range_bounds = no
                save_scope_as = oe_j7_r
            }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_j7_r } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_rest value = scope:oe_j7_r } }
}

# BYZ scope. The sultan backs the claimant unless outbid (design 3.6 .1: "没选 b 而 oe_j7_tur_ok 成立时").
oe_j7_after_1 = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_j7_outbid } oe_j7_tur_ok = yes } set_variable = oe_j7_tur_backs } }
# Any scope. The ending, kept on the empire and as a global for the chronicle and phase 2 (design 3.11).
oe_j7_set_end = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_j7_end value = $v$ }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_j7_end value = $v$ }
}
# BYZ scope. Pay $months$ months of income (oe_fin_month).
oe_j7_pay = { add_gold = { value = oe_fin_month multiply = -$months$ } }
# BYZ scope. Fires the hidden worker oe_j7.90 with job $j$ (changes of ruler stay out of the option previews).
oe_j7_run_job = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_j7_job value = $j$ }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_j7.90
}

# ---- the change of ruler and the co-emperor card: each in ONE effect (lessons of batches 6 and 7)
# BYZ scope. scope:oe_j7_new takes the throne (design 3.4): oe_succession_settled for 10 days (FX1: the first maker's
# old-dynasty restoration does not start), into the empire, out of prison, set_new_ruler; self-check: failure code
# $code$ when scope:oe_j7_new is not the ruler afterwards (nothing depends on it).
oe_j7_install = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_succession_settled days = 10 }
    scope:oe_j7_new = {
        if = { limit = { NOT = { owner ?= c:BYZ } } move_country = c:BYZ }
        release_character_from_prison_effect = yes
    }
    set_new_ruler = scope:oe_j7_new
    if = { limit = { NOT = { scope:oe_j7_new = { is_ruler_of = c:BYZ } } } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_fail value = $code$ } }
}
# BYZ scope. scope:oe_j7_c becomes the heir and, where the first maker's rules allow, co-emperor: his interaction's three
# steps copied (design 3.4; S37's oe_s37_crown_do did the same). Where the empire already has a co-emperor, only the
# heir. oe_j7_crowned: 1 the card given, 0 heir only. Self-check: failure code 41 when not the heir afterwards.
oe_j7_crown_co = {
    scope:oe_j7_c = {
        if = { limit = { NOT = { owner ?= c:BYZ } } move_country = c:BYZ }
        release_character_from_prison_effect = yes
    }
    set_as_designated_heir = scope:oe_j7_c
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_byz_imperial_honors_allowed = yes
            NOT = { oe_byz_has_co_emperor = yes }
            scope:oe_j7_c = { oe_byz_co_emperor_candidate = yes }
        }
        scope:oe_j7_c = {
            add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_byz_select_as_second_empire_mod mode = replace years = -1 }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_estate = estate_type:crown_estate } }
                change_character_estate = estate_type:crown_estate
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_byz_co_emperor_display value = scope:oe_j7_c }
        set_variable = { name = oe_j7_crowned value = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_j7_crowned value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { scope:oe_j7_c = { is_heir_of = c:BYZ } } } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_fail value = 41 } }
}
# BYZ scope. The new reign is over (after .3 or job 39, design 3.6): stage 9, the turmoil mark and the modifier go.
oe_j7_end_reign = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_j7_stage value = 9 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_turmoil } remove_variable = oe_j7_turmoil }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_j7_new_reign } remove_country_modifier = oe_j7_new_reign }
}
# BYZ scope. The restoration (design 3.7 job 31): the old emperor if alive, else the restorer; the restorer heir where he
# is not the new ruler; the claimant to the sultan (where the sultan backed him) or back to his appanage. res: 311 the
# old emperor, 312 the restorer, 313 the change did not take; 0 nobody to restore.
oe_j7_restore = {
    var:oe_j7_old ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes } save_scope_as = oe_j7_new } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_j7_new } } var:oe_j7_rest ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes } save_scope_as = oe_j7_new } } }
    var:oe_j7_claimant ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes } save_scope_as = oe_j7_cl } }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_j7_new }
        oe_j7_install = { code = 31 }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_j7_new = { is_ruler_of = c:BYZ } }
            if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_old ?= { this = scope:oe_j7_new } } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_res value = 311 } }
            else = { set_variable = { name = oe_j7_res value = 312 } }
            var:oe_j7_rest ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:BYZ NOT = { is_ruler_of = c:BYZ } } save_scope_as = oe_j7_rh } }
            if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_j7_rh } set_as_designated_heir = scope:oe_j7_rh }
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_j7_cl has_variable = oe_j7_tur_backs country_exists = c:TUR }
                scope:oe_j7_cl = { move_country = c:TUR }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_j7_cl }
                location:silivri = { if = { limit = { owner = c:BYZ } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_j7_appanage years = 10 mode = replace } } }
            }
            set_global_variable = oe_j7_restored
            var:oe_j7_old ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_fortress } remove_variable = oe_j7_fortress } }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_j7_res value = 313 } }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_j7_res value = 0 } }
    oe_j7_end_reign = yes
}
# BYZ scope. The claimant takes the throne (design 3.7 job 21): the old emperor stays in the empire, in the fortress;
# stage 2 (the new reign), the turmoil mark, global oe_j7_usurped (read by D2's .32 once its hook is in). Only when the
# change took (self-check, failure code 21).
oe_j7_usurp = {
    var:oe_j7_claimant ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes } save_scope_as = oe_j7_new } }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_j7_new }
        oe_j7_install = { code = 21 }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_j7_new = { is_ruler_of = c:BYZ } }
            var:oe_j7_old ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes } set_variable = oe_j7_fortress } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_j7_stage value = 2 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_j7_um value = 0 }
            set_variable = oe_j7_turmoil
            set_global_variable = oe_j7_usurped
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_j7_new_reign months = 2 mode = replace }
        }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_j7_fail value = 21 } }
}
# BYZ scope. The phase is closed (1393.1.1): a new reign still running counts as held (end 6).
oe_j7_close = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_j7_stage ?= 2 }
        oe_j7_set_end = { v = 6 }
        set_global_variable = oe_j7_reign
        oe_j7_end_reign = yes
    }
    set_variable = oe_j7_off
    debug_log = "oe_j7: the line is closed (st [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_j7_rd_st')|0], end [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_j7_rd_end')|0])"
}

# ---- the worker's jobs (oe_j7.90); the rolls use oe_j7_roll_force once (buttons j7roll0 / j7roll1: 1 fails, 2 succeeds)
oe_j7_roll_for = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_j7_roll value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_roll_force ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_roll value = 1 } }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_j7_roll_force } }
        random = { chance = $chance$ set_variable = { name = oe_j7_roll value = 1 } }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_roll_force } remove_variable = oe_j7_roll_force }
}
# 20: .2 b, the street roll (oe_j7_street_roll), then 22 or 23, then the notice.
oe_j7_job_20 = {
    oe_j7_roll_for = { chance = oe_j7_street_roll }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_roll = 1 } oe_j7_job_22 = yes }
    else = { oe_j7_job_23 = yes }
    remove_variable = oe_j7_roll
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_j7.91
}
# 21: .2 a, the claimant takes the throne; the old emperor withdraws to the fortress.
oe_j7_job_21 = { oe_j7_usurp = yes }
# 22: the street won (end 1): the claimant to the sultan where the sultan backed him, else imprisoned 5 years
# (a claimant abroad stays where he is); prestige. res 221 / 222.
oe_j7_job_22 = {
    var:oe_j7_claimant ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes } save_scope_as = oe_j7_cl } }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_j7_cl has_variable = oe_j7_tur_backs country_exists = c:TUR }
        scope:oe_j7_cl = { move_country = c:TUR }
        set_variable = { name = oe_j7_res value = 221 }
    }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_j7_cl scope:oe_j7_cl = { owner ?= c:BYZ } } scope:oe_j7_cl = { imprison_character_effect = { years = 5 } } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_j7_res value = 222 }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_tur_backs } remove_variable = oe_j7_tur_backs }
    add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
    set_variable = { name = oe_j7_st_3 value = 4 }
    oe_j7_set_end = { v = 1 }
}
# 23: the street lost: as 21, and the old emperor imprisoned 5 years; stability. res 223 / 224 (no change).
oe_j7_job_23 = {
    oe_j7_usurp = yes
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_j7_stage ?= 2 }
        var:oe_j7_old ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:BYZ } imprison_character_effect = { years = 5 } } }
        set_variable = oe_j7_street_lost
        add_stability = stability_weak_penalty
        set_variable = { name = oe_j7_res value = 223 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_j7_res value = 224 } }
}
# 30: .3 a, the restoration roll (oe_j7_restore_roll), then 31 or 32, then the notice.
oe_j7_job_30 = {
    oe_j7_roll_for = { chance = oe_j7_restore_roll }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_roll = 1 } oe_j7_job_31 = yes }
    else = { oe_j7_job_32 = yes }
    remove_variable = oe_j7_roll
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_j7.91
}
# 31: restored by the galleys (end 5).
oe_j7_job_31 = { oe_j7_restore = yes oe_j7_set_end = { v = 5 } }
# 32: the restoration failed (end 6): the old emperor imprisoned 5 years; the new reign holds. res 321.
oe_j7_job_32 = {
    var:oe_j7_old ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:BYZ } imprison_character_effect = { years = 5 } } }
    set_global_variable = oe_j7_reign
    set_variable = { name = oe_j7_res value = 321 }
    oe_j7_end_reign = yes
    oe_j7_set_end = { v = 6 }
}
# 33: .3 c, the new emperor accepted (end 6): the old emperor retires, out of prison; the restorer aggrieved where he is
# an adult in the empire (phase 2 reads oe_j7_rest_bitter).
oe_j7_job_33 = {
    var:oe_j7_old ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes } set_variable = oe_j7_retired release_character_from_prison_effect = yes } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_rest ?= { is_alive = yes is_adult = yes owner ?= c:BYZ } } set_variable = oe_j7_rest_bitter }
    set_global_variable = oe_j7_reign
    oe_j7_end_reign = yes
    oe_j7_set_end = { v = 6 }
}
# 34: .3 b, restored by the sultan's judgement, without a roll (end 7).
oe_j7_job_34 = { oe_j7_restore = yes oe_j7_set_end = { v = 7 } }
# 39: from the monthly round, the claimant died while reigning: restored without a roll (end 10). res 391 / 392, or 393
# when nobody is left to restore (the engine's succession stands).
oe_j7_job_39 = {
    oe_j7_restore = yes
    if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_res ?= 311 } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_res value = 391 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_res ?= 312 } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_res value = 392 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_j7_res value = 393 } }
    oe_j7_set_end = { v = 10 }
}
# 41: .1 d / .2 c, the claimant becomes heir and, where allowed, co-emperor.
oe_j7_job_41 = {
    var:oe_j7_claimant ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes } save_scope_as = oe_j7_c } }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_j7_c } oe_j7_crown_co = yes }
}
# ---- phase 2 (design 3.8). .4 and .5 have only light effects, written in their options; .6 a goes through the worker.
# 61: .6 a, the reconciliation roll (oe_j7_recon_roll), then 62 or 63, then the notice.
oe_j7_job_61 = {
    oe_j7_roll_for = { chance = oe_j7_recon_roll }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_roll = 1 } oe_j7_job_62 = yes }
    else = { oe_j7_job_63 = yes }
    remove_variable = oe_j7_roll
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_j7.91
}
# 62: the claimant comes back (end2 1): into the empire, out of prison; oe_j7_reconciled (read by C7's regent once its
# hook is in, design 4.2 item 4); the co-emperor card where the first maker's rules allow, NOT the heir (design 3.8 .6,
# 六 12). Self-check: failure code 61 when the claimant is not in the empire afterwards. res 611 card / 612 / 613.
oe_j7_job_62 = {
    var:oe_j7_claimant ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes } save_scope_as = oe_j7_c } }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_j7_c }
        scope:oe_j7_c = {
            if = { limit = { NOT = { owner ?= c:BYZ } is_ruler = no } move_country = c:BYZ }
            release_character_from_prison_effect = yes
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_j7_c scope:oe_j7_c = { owner ?= c:BYZ } }
        set_variable = oe_j7_reconciled
        set_global_variable = oe_j7_reconciled
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_tur_backs } remove_variable = oe_j7_tur_backs }
        oe_j7_card = yes
        if = { limit = { var:oe_j7_rcrowned ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_res value = 611 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_j7_res value = 612 } }
        oe_j7_set_end2 = { v = 1 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_j7_fail value = 61 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_j7_res value = 613 }
        oe_j7_set_end2 = { v = 2 }
    }
    oe_j7_stop_pension = yes
}
# 63: the claimant would not come back (end2 2). res 621.
oe_j7_job_63 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_j7_res value = 621 }
    oe_j7_set_end2 = { v = 2 }
    oe_j7_stop_pension = yes
}
# BYZ scope. scope:oe_j7_c (in the empire) gets the first maker's co-emperor card where his rules allow: the three steps of
# his interaction, as oe_j7_crown_co, but without set_as_designated_heir. oe_j7_rcrowned: 1 given, 0 not.
oe_j7_card = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_byz_imperial_honors_allowed = yes
            NOT = { oe_byz_has_co_emperor = yes }
            scope:oe_j7_c = { oe_byz_co_emperor_candidate = yes }
        }
        scope:oe_j7_c = {
            add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_byz_select_as_second_empire_mod mode = replace years = -1 }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_estate = estate_type:crown_estate } }
                change_character_estate = estate_type:crown_estate
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_byz_co_emperor_display value = scope:oe_j7_c }
        set_variable = { name = oe_j7_rcrowned value = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_j7_rcrowned value = 0 } }
}
# Any scope. Phase 2's ending (1 reconciled, 2 would not come, 3 the emperor refused, 4 the claimant died, 5 passed),
# on the empire and as a global for the chronicle and phase 3. .6 is settled with it.
oe_j7_set_end2 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_j7_end2 value = $v$ }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_j7_end2 value = $v$ }
}
# BYZ scope, monthly (phase 2). After a restoration (endings 5, 7) .4 is decided once: due after the sultan's judgement
# (.3 b), else 25% while the sultan can back anyone; not due = st_4 3. Then its counter; the pension.
oe_j7_p2_tick = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_j7_need_4 = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_j7_w4 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_j7_w4 value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_sultan_price } set_variable = oe_j7_due4 }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_j7_tur_ok = yes } random = { chance = 25 set_variable = oe_j7_due4 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_j7_due4 } } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_st_4 value = 3 } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_due4 NOT = { has_variable = oe_j7_st_4 } has_variable = oe_j7_w4 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_j7_w4 add = 1 }
    }
    oe_j7_pension_tick = yes
}
# BYZ scope, monthly. The pension of .5 a: every 12 months one month of income, while payments are left; it stops when
# the claimant is dead or reconciled, and stops unpaid (oe_j7_pension_cut, -10 on .6) when the gold is short.
oe_j7_pension_tick = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_pension }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { oe_j7_has_claim = no has_variable = oe_j7_reconciled } }
            oe_j7_stop_pension = yes
        }
        else = {
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_pen_m } change_variable = { name = oe_j7_pen_m add = 1 } } else = { set_variable = { name = oe_j7_pen_m value = 1 } }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_j7_pen_m >= 12 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_j7_pen_m value = 0 }
                if = {
                    limit = { oe_j7_can_pay = { months = 1 } }
                    oe_j7_pay = { months = 1 }
                    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_pen_paid } change_variable = { name = oe_j7_pen_paid add = 1 } } else = { set_variable = { name = oe_j7_pen_paid value = 1 } }
                    change_variable = { name = oe_j7_pension add = -1 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = oe_j7_pension_cut
                    oe_j7_stop_pension = yes
                }
            }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_pension var:oe_j7_pension <= 0 } oe_j7_stop_pension = yes }
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. The pension ends (no more payments; what was paid stays counted in oe_j7_pen_paid).
oe_j7_stop_pension = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_pension } remove_variable = oe_j7_pension }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_pen_m } remove_variable = oe_j7_pen_m }
}
# phase 3: the jobs of .7 (the court at Thessalonica) and .8 (the funeral) go here.

# ---- test buttons only (DEV_LINES)
# BYZ scope. The test claimant (age 20) and the test restorer (age 25), adults in any year (a 1337 test game has no adult
# princes, r18); the restorer is made heir and kept as oe_j7_rest_test. Each is made once.
oe_j7_test_make = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = character:oe_j7_t_claim } }
        create_character = { first_name = name_john female = no dynasty = dynasty:palaiologos_dynasty culture = culture:greek_culture religion = religion:orthodox birth_location = location:constantinople age = 20 script = oe_j7_t_claim }
    }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = character:oe_j7_t_rest } }
        create_character = { first_name = name_emmanuel female = no dynasty = dynasty:palaiologos_dynasty culture = culture:greek_culture religion = religion:orthodox birth_location = location:constantinople age = 25 script = oe_j7_t_rest }
    }
    character:oe_j7_t_claim ?= { save_scope_as = oe_j7_tc }
    character:oe_j7_t_rest ?= { save_scope_as = oe_j7_tr }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_j7_tc } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_claimant value = scope:oe_j7_tc } }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_j7_tr } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_rest_test value = scope:oe_j7_tr } set_as_designated_heir = scope:oe_j7_tr }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_j7_live } } set_global_variable = oe_j7_live }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_j7_on } } set_variable = oe_j7_on }
}
# BYZ scope. Show .1 / .2 / .3 now through its sender: the date, the window, the chance, the lock and calm are left
# out; the event's own trigger (who must be there) is still checked.
oe_j7_test_1 = {

    else = { debug_log = "oe_j7 test: .1 cannot be shown (no claimant who is an adult man in the empire, not ruler, not heir, not imprisoned: press j7mk)" }
}
oe_j7_test_2 = {

    if = { limit = { oe_j7_ev_2 = yes } oe_j7_send_2 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_j7 test: .2 cannot be shown (no claimant who can strike, or the City is not ours: press j7mk)" }

}
# BYZ scope. Switch "the sultan backs the claimant" (oe_j7_tur_backs) on, or off again.

    else = { set_variable = oe_j7_tur_backs }
}

oe_j7_test_roll = { set_variable = { name = oe_j7_roll_force value = $r$ } }

    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_j7_end } remove_global_variable = oe_j7_end }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_j7_second_slighted } remove_global_variable = oe_j7_second_slighted }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_j7_reconciled } remove_global_variable = oe_j7_reconciled }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_j7_end2 } remove_global_variable = oe_j7_end2 }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_j7_new_reign } remove_country_modifier = oe_j7_new_reign }
    location:silivri = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_j7_appanage } remove_location_modifier = oe_j7_appanage } }
    location:constantinople = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_j7_gate_razed } remove_location_modifier = oe_j7_gate_razed } }
}
# ---- phase 2 test buttons
# BYZ scope. Put the line at the start of phase 2 as if the galleys had restored the old reign (ending 5): .1-.3 shown,
# the new reign over, the line open again, phase 2's own state cleared. The ruler, the heir and the persons stay as they
# are (press j7mk first for a claimant).
oe_j7_test_p2 = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_off } remove_variable = oe_j7_off }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_w4 } remove_variable = oe_j7_w4 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_due4 } remove_variable = oe_j7_due4 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_n5 } remove_variable = oe_j7_n5 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_m5 } remove_variable = oe_j7_m5 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_way4 } remove_variable = oe_j7_way4 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_way5 } remove_variable = oe_j7_way5 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_way6 } remove_variable = oe_j7_way6 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_ignored } remove_variable = oe_j7_ignored }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_venice } remove_variable = oe_j7_venice }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_pension } remove_variable = oe_j7_pension }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_pen_m } remove_variable = oe_j7_pen_m }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_pen_paid } remove_variable = oe_j7_pen_paid }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_pension_cut } remove_variable = oe_j7_pension_cut }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_recon_pct } remove_variable = oe_j7_recon_pct }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_reconciled } remove_variable = oe_j7_reconciled }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_rcrowned } remove_variable = oe_j7_rcrowned }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_end2 } remove_variable = oe_j7_end2 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_st_4 } remove_variable = oe_j7_st_4 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_st_5 } remove_variable = oe_j7_st_5 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_st_6 } remove_variable = oe_j7_st_6 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_j7_reconciled } remove_global_variable = oe_j7_reconciled }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_j7_end2 } remove_global_variable = oe_j7_end2 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_j7_st_1 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_st_2 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_st_3 value = 1 }
    oe_j7_end_reign = yes
    oe_j7_set_end = { v = 5 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_j7_restored } } set_global_variable = oe_j7_restored }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_j7_live } } set_global_variable = oe_j7_live }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_j7_on } } set_variable = oe_j7_on }
    set_variable = { name = oe_j7_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
}
# BYZ scope. Show .4 / .5 / .6 now through its sender: the date, the window, the chance, the lock and calm are left out;
# the event's own trigger is still checked. .4 is made due first.
oe_j7_test_4 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_j7_w4 } } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_w4 value = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_j7_due4 } } set_variable = oe_j7_due4 }
    if = { limit = { oe_j7_ev_4 = yes } oe_j7_send_4 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_j7 test: .4 cannot be shown (no sultan who can ask, or the City is not ours)" }
}
oe_j7_test_5 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_j7_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { oe_j7_ev_5 = yes } oe_j7_send_5 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_j7 test: .5 cannot be shown (no claimant who is a free adult man, not ruler, not heir, in the empire or with the Genoese or the sultan: press j7mk)" }
}
oe_j7_test_6 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_j7_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { oe_j7_ev_6 = yes } oe_j7_send_6 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_j7 test: .6 cannot be shown (no claimant who is a free adult man, not ruler, not heir, in the empire or with the Genoese or the sultan: press j7mk)" }
}
# BYZ scope. Settle one year of the pension now (after .5 a).
oe_j7_test_pension = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_j7_pension } set_variable = { name = oe_j7_pen_m value = 11 } oe_j7_pension_tick = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_j7 test: no pension runs (choose .5 a first)" }
}
# BYZ scope. Send the claimant to the sultan (to try .6's way back; the claimant must not be the ruler).
oe_j7_test_away = {
    var:oe_j7_claimant ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes is_ruler = no } save_scope_as = oe_j7_c } }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_j7_c country_exists = c:TUR }
        scope:oe_j7_c = { move_country = c:TUR }
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_j7 test: no claimant to send, or no Ottomans (press j7mk)" }
}
